saints.name: St. Virgil of Salzburg
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: An Irish monk and man of learning who became Bishop of Salzburg and Apostle of Carinthia…
biography: Virgil, whose Irish name was Fergal, was a monk and scholar who left Ireland for the Continent in the eighth century. After a time at the court of Pepin, he came to Bavaria and was placed over the church of Salzburg, of which he became bishop, building its first cathedral and sending missionaries to the pagan Slavs of Carinthia.

A man of wide learning, he was noted for his knowledge of cosmology and famously held that the earth was a sphere with inhabited antipodes, a view that drew the suspicion of St. Boniface but did not condemn him. He died at Salzburg on 27 November 784 and is honoured as the Apostle of Carinthia.
saints.knownFor: The see of Salzburg and the evangelization of Carinthia.
